description: Land  Title Settlement Department  - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1616/18 of 24.08.2009 Homagama D/S Division,  Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and land locations in various divisions and districts. The content focuses on correcting/amending land title records and is published in the "PART III - LANDS" section, making it clearly a land-related matter falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
